Inclusion Criteria (PTA group)
  -  T1D  [AND] patients who received their first PTA, [OR]  or second PTA  [AND] only if their first graft was explanted within a week, between 2 January 2005 and 31 December 2017
  -  age ≥18  [AND] and < 65 years
  -  willingness to participate in this observational study
Inclusion Criteria (control group)
  -  Type 1 diabetes
  -  age ≥18 years  [AND] and < 65 years
  -  willingness to participate in this observational study
  -  minimum disease duration of 5 years
  -  brittle diabetes, as defined by the occurrence of frequent acute complications (ketoacidosis  [OR] or severe hypoglycaemic episodes requiring third-part assistance  [OR] or unawareness  [AND] despite well-conducted intensive insulin therapy)
  -  presence of at least one diabetes-related complication (either neuropathy, [OR]  retinopathy, subclinical nephropathy)

Exclusion Criteria (both groups)
  -  conditions other than T1D known to affect bone health (i

, non-compensated hypothyroidism, [OR]  hyperthyroidism, [OR]  hyperparathyroidism, [OR]  inflammatory bowel disease, [OR]  malignancy, [OR]  rheumatoid arthritis, [OR]  hypogonadism, severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, [OR]  hepatic insufficiency, [OR]  alcohol intake ≥ 3 units/day ),
  -  use of drugs that can affect bone metabolism (e

, bisphosphonates, [OR]  anticonvulsants, [OR]  hormone replacement therapy) other than glucocorticoids  [OR] and immunosuppressants
  -  recipients of simultaneous pancreas kidney transplantation, [OR]  pancreatic islet transplantation, multiple PTAs, other transplants
  -  BMI <18
